description: Queue one existing monitor to run on the scheduler's next tick instead of waiting out its interval, for example to confirm a fix. It returns the monitor record, not a check result: call get_monitor or list_check_results a moment later for the outcome. To probe a target that has no monitor yet use check_target; to restart a paused monitor use resume_monitor. Requires a key with the write scope. A repeat call for the same monitor within 30 seconds, or a call on a paused monitor, is a silent no-op that returns it unchanged. Calls are limited to 10 per minute per calling address (not per key or organization); past that it is a 429 with the seconds to wait, so pace a run over many monitors.

monitor_id.description: The monitor's uuid from list_monitors. An id that is not a monitor of this organization, or a deleted one, is a 404.
